id.description: Becomes the git branch name trellis/<id>.

goal.description: Three sentences max. What must exist when this is done.

write.description: Only paths the worker may create or modify. Must be disjoint from any node that can run concurrently.

read.description: Read-only context. Keep to ~3 files; cheap models degrade with long context.

tests.description: Frozen test files. Must already exist. Workers cannot modify them.

gate.description: Shell command that must exit 0. Scope it to this node's tests.

risk.description: high = hold unmerged for review and stall dependants (leaf nodes only). audit = merge and flag for reading afterwards.

tags.description: Short labels for the KIND of work (adapter, parser, algorithm, glue, crud). How the ledger generalises across runs.

mutations.description: Plain-language descriptions of plausible-wrong implementations. Reintroduced into the accepted code after the node passes; the tests must catch each one.

covers.description: Scope bullets from the spec's 'Scope for this run' that this node satisfies. An unclaimed bullet fails validation.
